notes.title: Trading Cards are added!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, friends![/h2]

[h3]We've added trading cards to the game! [/h3]

The collectibles are now available, so have fun getting them while playing. There are some fine pieces! 

The community items are still in the moderation queue. We're trying to make as many backgrounds as possible, including animated ones, but there are requirements we have to follow in order to get the approval. However, we've fit all of the characters into them, so you will be packed with beautiful girls.

Other items are also queued for moderation. We can't wait to finally share everything with you, let's ask Santa to make this happen fasterːls_heartː

notes.title: Halloween update is here!
notes.content:
Hey there friends!

It’s Spooky Season again! Let’s have as much fun as possible with the Halloween update!
The girls and their partners are back with a set of mini stories complete with bonus artworks. 

Become a detective and infiltrate the mafia, help with shooting a pin-up calendar, find out how nurse uniforms can become even sexier, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/bc48263eababb8ee80a735ddc7134990ea07c3a4.png[/img]

It’s time for you to choose a costume for your roommates' party, and you better find a really cool one for the girls to enjoy. Or, choose a trip to the 2000s together with a rock band with a spicy twist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/c76ab254976de6b42a9ce5859e926a01afe239ef.png[/img]

Paired with match-3, it's a short but festive adventure coming from us straight to your PCs with loads of love.

Thank you for always supporting us on various platforms, having fun conversations and making more games come to life. We also remember that community items are still on us, but sometimes the process takes longer than expected, so let’s forgive our big boss Drakonika and let her cook a little bit longer. Promise the items will be awesome, and loads of them!

Our friends' game is soon to be released, so if you like battles and women, check out [b]Sexy Iron Maidens[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686320/Sexy_Iron_Maidens/

And don't miss out on our next project - [b]Dungeons and Furries[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953170/Dungeons__Furries/

Don’t forget to subscribe to our social media and leave your comments about the update. 

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Follow us on Bluesky: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/furlough-games.bsky.social]https://bsky.app/profile/furlough-games.bsky.social[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url] 

See you in the next one!

XOXO
Shane

notes.title: SEX AND THE FURRY TITTY 3 - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]ːls_heartːSEX AND THE FURRY TITTY IS OUTːls_heartː[/h2]

[h2]We're back with a new set of stories - hotter, deeper, funnier![/h2]

Are you in a desperate need of a good love story combined with hottest animated scenes under the star light? We've got you! Want to know how to run for the elections in your local city government and not lose the love of your life but find an extra shoulder to hold on to?  The answer is right here! 

Help Bella become a mayor and set up a date for the two aspiring rock stars after the rehearsal - so many  routes to choose from here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/1f6ff3156415aefa08837f20f92da58721ad6132.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/3cc02c0eca486b90f2923dfdc59f34600c3f8d0c.png[/img]

Look after the gorgeous naughty nurse Kira ready to give a helping hand to a poor boy... Or even her bust and other private parts. Promise it won't hurt one bit, sweetheart! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/7854eac0a1eda8806a78de86c164117a9fa70915.png[/img]

See how lucky you can get in co-renting an apartment with two gorgeous girls. Help Kristin with her freelance work and take care of Sarah after her long day at the office. They love you, you love them - it all goes smooth like butter, buddy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/498dc51dc207ce71445f1fb7063b61f003f737aa.png[/img]

Help Margo behave well in strong manly arms of her old friend, who alsho happens to know how to pleasure a woman seven days a week. Even Mistresses need to unwind sometimes, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/ad9e642602b0a4b9abd96d41aaf5aeca52522e61.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of life is right around the corner![/h2]

No more grinding: just turn on the unlimited turns feature and enjoy your favorite puzzles in a relaxed manner - with one hand! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/25f734fbe316d739de873565e35b2b7b1ac57f9c.png[/img]

Those items won't distract you from the main course anymore... unless you're up for a challenge, of course! We're all here for the plot and puzzles, after all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/add151913e33ad58d3b6db70e9b9b25f2dd0bc69.png[/img]

[h2]And what's to come next? [/h2]

Right now we're going to take a short break before we get our hands on Mansion Of Memories and continue working on it full time (you can tell it's been tough for us to balance this project with others). Expect more updates on Mansion Of Memories soon and don't forget to wishlist it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

However, our plans don't stop there. We've launched new game pages for our other projects that will come with some new features like customizable gender (hopefully as many combinations as possible for us to handle!). I guess you can call it a road map of some sorts. We will be taking our time and releasing the games once they are ready, so no actual dates for now. Tell us in the comments which game picks your interest, it's for science!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953140/Furry_Fairy_Tales/]][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/065c55360f452a2a5889b8f522b4e4bdc0c44935.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953060/Furry_from_Outer_Space/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/9881151536359b3aaff4f51b559e77afe0392ece.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953170/Dungeons__Furries/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/5471d7dfe7120f7a86962c68de16e0071c364e0e.png[/img][/url]

Thank you so much for staying with us and helping us develop the games of our dreams. Enjoy the game, don't forget to share your impressions about the stories in the comment section and in our social media accounts. 

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url] 


We love you to the moon and back!

XO
Shane

notes.title: SEX AND THE FURRY TITTY 3 DEMO IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Sex And The Furry Titty 3 DEMO is here![/h1]

Have you dreamt of becoming a musician and have the hottest bassist ever beside you? Maybe, you're in desperate need of a new housing? Or your body is in a desperate need of professional care? 

I get it, you can't wait anymore! It's time to unpack the God's menu and show you what we've been cooking. Try out three new stories right here, right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/13e2fbcca48941ceb4075a6706fb97d7f55add3d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/e5e405fae58c994b44737d6b0c0fae6ab336149d.png[/img]

Accompanied by undying classic puzzle, these stories won't leave you indifferent. And that's just an 
aperitif, it only gets hotter from here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/66fb819cb8f71d0274b68abb983b84598a54de86.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/a44d4ec30d9823eb3281a8b1bd257ef69f7185e6.png[/img]

[h2]Small changes - big difference![/h2]

We're breathing new life into the classic game of 3-in-row now, and it's time to introduce our new feature: unlimited turns! For those who enjoy the casual playstyle and are invested in the story - just check the box and enjoy the game with one hand, basically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/771c200313ecc8091d93761b6be2459b3a47f445.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/74346876c100fdbfda4e4c9e9d55f325d8e8e755.png[/img]

Of course, we don't stop here. The main course will have everything you love about our games - chili hot stories, finger-licking animations and tip-worthy voice-acting. 

Give our other projects some love as well and wishlist them now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

Enjoy the demo, follow our social media for extra content and talk to the team every now and then on Discord! 

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url] 

I'll see you in the next one.

XO
Shane
